ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 35% high-intensity (white/off-white) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white patches located at the lateral distal margins of both lobes. The central region near the peduncle is solid low-intensity black. The right lobe shows a large, solid white area with internal black mottling, while the left lobe displays more fragmented white streaks and scattered white pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 50-60 degrees; depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing boundary. The left lobe distal edge features deeper, more irregular jaggedness compared to the slightly smoother serrations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve sweeping upwards and outwards from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring. Two distinct side-by-side circles are visible on the lower-left white patch; several single circular marks are distributed across the right lobe's white and black transition areas.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions. Vertical parallel rake marks are clearly visible on the white section of the right lobe; several finer, diagonal white scratches are present on the black skin of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of vertical rake marks on the right lobe and multiple circular parasitic/barnacle scars on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct yellowish-orange pixel cluster/growth is visible on the extreme outer tip of the left lobe.
